verdict.rationale: Attio ships an official, extensively documented App SDK. It uses TypeScript and React and covers extensions, pages, workflow blocks, a GraphQL data API, server functions and webhook handlers. It is explicitly designed for AI-assisted development, with bootstrapped AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files. A public OpenAPI 3.1 spec backs the REST API. Missing for 10: official language client SDKs (e.g., Node/Python) for the REST API beyond the in-Attio App SDK, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Attio App SDK lets you extend Attio with your own functionality. Apps run inside Attio's infrastructure and can surface custom UI directly inside Attio's interface.
The App SDK was designed from the ground up to enable AI-assisted development. It uses React and TypeScript, tools which LLMs understand well.
Every new app comes bootstrapped with a default AGENTS.md file. We additionally supply a CLAUDE.md file to provide instructions for Claude Code users.
The App SDK provides a GraphQL API for querying data within Attio.
Server functions let you make HTTP requests from your app, whether it's to a third-party API, or to the Attio REST API using ATTIO_API_TOKEN
